description: This script monitors filesystem and central storage statistics for the jwql application, gathers data, updates database tables, and generates plots for filesystem usage over time.

methods.name: gather_statistics
methods.description: Walks the filesystem to gather statistics such as file counts and sizes, and populates dictionaries for database storage.

methods.name: get_global_filesystem_stats
methods.description: Retrieves used and available disk space statistics for the entire filesystem.

methods.name: get_area_stats
methods.description: Gathers disk space statistics for specific central storage areas.

methods.name: initialize_results_dicts
methods.description: Initializes dictionaries to hold filesystem and storage statistics.

methods.name: monitor_filesystem
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates data collection, database update, and plotting of filesystem statistics.

methods.name: plot_by_filetype
methods.description: Creates plots of file counts or sizes by file type over time for specified instruments or all.

methods.name: plot_filesystem_size
methods.description: Plots total filesystem size, used space, and free space over time.

methods.name: plot_central_store_dirs
methods.description: Plots sizes and used space of central storage directories over time.

methods.name: plot_filesystem_stats
methods.description: Generates and saves various filesystem statistics plots.

methods.name: plot_total_file_counts
methods.description: Plots total file counts over time.

methods.name: update_database
methods.description: Inserts collected statistics into the database tables.
